div.head: Rect 4.3, 4.3a, 4.3b, 4.3c
div.ab: [4.3] On ðam sylfum lande, ðe ðeos ræden on stænt, gebure gebyreð, þæt him man to landsetene sylle II oxan 7 I cu 7 VI sceap 7 VII æceras gesawene on his gyrde landes. [4.3a] Forðige ofer þæt gear ealle gerihtu, ðe him to gebyrigean. [4.3b] 7 sylle him man tol to his weorce 7 andlaman to his huse. [4.3c] Ðonne him forðsi[ð] gebyrige, gyme his hlaford ðæs he læfe.

[4.3] In ipsa terra, ubi hec consuetudo stat, moris est, ut ad terram assidendam dentur ei duo boues et una uacca et VI oues et VII acre seminate in sua uirgata terrę. [4.3a] Post illum annum faciat omnes rectitudines, que ad eum attinent. [4.3b] Et committantur ei tela ad opus suum et suppellex ad domum suam. [4.3c] Si mortem obeat, rehabeat dominus suus omnia.

On ðam sylfum lande ðe ðeos ræden on stænt gebu|re gebyreð þæt him man to landsetene sylle . ii. oxan. 7. i. cu . 7. vi.sceap.7 vii . æceras ge|sawene on his gyrde landes. forðige ofer þæt gear ealle gerihtu ðe him to gebyrigean . 7 sylle him man tol to his weorce 7 andlaman to his huse . ðonne him forðsit [read as 6 ‘sið’] gebyrige gy|me his hlaford ðæs he læfe.

On ðam sylfum lande ðe ðeos ræden on stænt, gebure gebyreð þæt him man to landsetene sylle II oxan and I cu and VI sceap and VII æceras gesawene on his gyrde landes. Forðige ofer þæt gear ealle gerihtu, ðe him to gebyrigean. And sylle him man tol to his weorce and andlaman to his huse. Đonne him forðsið gebyrige, gyme his hlaford ðæs he læfe.

On the same estate which this custom stands, it is fitting to give to the peasant [as needed] for settling the land, two oxen and one cow and six sheep and seven acres [already] sewn on his strip of land. After the [first] year is over he must fulfil all the duties which pertain to him. And one should give to him tools for his work and utensils for his house. When he dies, the lord should care for that which he leaves [behind].

On the same estate on which this custom is observed, it is appropriate that the tenant farmer be given for the cultivation of the land two oxen, one cow, six sheep, and seven acres already sown on his allotment of land. Let him perform all the duties assigned to him over the course of the year. And let him be given the tools for his labor and the utensils for his house. When he dies, his lord should oversee whatever he leaves behind.

[4.3] Auf demselben Gute, auf dem obige Regelung gilt, kommt dem Bauern zu, dass man [die Herrschaft] ihm als Bodeninventar [zur Landbesiedlung, indem sie die Bauernhofstelle besetzt] 2 Ochsen und 1 Kuh und 6 Schafe und auf seine ‘Ruthe’ Landes [meist ¼ Hide, 30 Äcker] 7 Äcker besät übergebe. [4.3a] Er vollziehe nach diesem [Antritts]jahr alle Rechtspflichten, die ihm zukommen. [4.3b] Und man [die Herrschaft] gebe ihm Werkzeug für seine Arbeit und Geräthe für sein Haus. [4.3c] Wenn ihn der Tod trifft, halte sich sein Herr [wegen des Hofinventars] an das, was er [der Bauer] hinterlässt.

[4.3] On the same estate where the above arrangement holds, it is due to the gebur that [the lord] should give him as stock for the land [for settling the holding] 2 oxen and 1 cow and 6 sheep, and 7 acres sown on his yardland [usually ¼ hide, 30 acres]. [4.3a] After that [first] year let him perform all the duties that are due from him. [4.3b] And let [the lord] give him tools for his work and utensils for his house. [4.3c] When death befalls him, let his lord take charge of what he [the gebur] leaves [on account of the farm stock].

note.quote: 'he who administers the shire should take care (hede se ðe scire healde)' — exactly this phrase recurs early on in Gerefa

div.note: This row combines Liebermann's 4.3–4.3c. B reads ‘forðsit’; Liebermann prints ‘forðsi[ð]’ (compare 5.5). Liebermann compares Ger 14. K: a missing space and a double space corrected.
